page.layout: One page, title page. Centred lines of print from top to bottom: the title, the subtitle, the author's name and office, the place of printing, a woodcut printer's device (oval, with no text) in the middle, then the place and the printer's imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: In quibus vindicatur doctrina orthodoxa de divinis
decretis, & Dei tum æterni decreti, tum gratiæ
Adversus Iacobum Arminium ejusque asseclas, & Iesuitas,
inprimis vero Fran. Suarezium, Gabri. Vasquezium,
Lodiv. Molinam, Leonard. Lessium, Pet. Fonsecam & Robertum Bellarminum.
Ecclesiæ Anwetensis, in Gallovidia Scotiæ Provincia, Pastoris.

page.notes: The oval woodcut printer's device in the middle of the page has no text and is not transcribed. A handwritten inscription in ink at the right, beside the device ("Thomas F. ..."), is not printed and is left out. The final letter of "Dhüiringh" is doubtful: the printed form may differ, so it is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The printed line "Lodiv." keeps its full stop as printed.
